committed_before_execution: this file is committed to the cycle branch BEFORE any execution of evaluation.retrieval_instrument_falsification; the git commit time is the freeze evidence, not a hand-written timestamp field
question: FAST MVP MODE: the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority benchmark must be able to FALSIFY the product. The counter-authority half already can (evaluation.benchmark_retrieval_counter_authority legs 2-3 prove the label and geometry gates fail deliberately regressed packets). The retrieval half cannot yet: no executable leg proves the frozen retrieval instrument reproduces the accepted run of record AND can fail a deliberately regressed multilingual retrieval record. Does it?
product_decision_unlocked: whether the factory may keep citing the frozen retrieval benchmark (spec 187b0e54...) as a live falsifier of retrieval regressions, especially on the FR/DE/IT authority-recall cells that the accepted frontier OUTCOME_B negative leaves unrecovered. If the reproduction leg diverges from the accepted run of record, the instrument itself is defective and must never be cited; if the falsification legs do not fire, the retrieval gates are vacuous and every past retrieval verdict is suspect.
frozen_scoring_entry_point: evaluation.retrieval_gate.gates.evaluate - a pure function (same spec + same record -> byte-identical verdict). No gate is re-implemented, no threshold is re-derived, no frozen file is written.

frozen_legs.leg_a_reproduction: re-score the accepted run of record through gates.evaluate; the failed-gate list, the not-measurable-gate list, the four counts and overall_pass must equal the accepted_reading exactly (lists compared as SETS, counts as integers)
frozen_legs.leg_b_hostile_blank: copy the accepted record and set rows/ids/n_results to empty on exactly the query_key baseline:corporate-criminal-liability:de (a currently PASSING multilingual cell, 2 hits); re-score; the failed-gate set must grow by EXACTLY {authority::baseline_lang_recall::corporate-criminal-liability::de, authority::baseline_recall::corporate-criminal-liability} and lose NOTHING; the de cells of the other two measurable legs (business-judgment-rule::de, petty-theft-dismissal::de) must remain passing
frozen_legs.leg_c_hostile_duplicate: copy the accepted record and append a deep copy of rows[0] to exactly the query_key counter:rent-default:fr (a leg whose duplicate gate currently PASSES); re-score; the failed-gate set must grow by EXACTLY {duplicate::unique_ids::rent-default} and lose NOTHING

success_rule.exit_0: REPRODUCTION_MATCHES_AND_FALSIFICATION_PROVEN - every pinned digest matches AND leg A matches the accepted reading AND leg B adds exactly its two named gates with the two named de cells still passing AND leg C adds exactly its one named gate
success_rule.exit_1: FALSIFICATION_OR_REPRODUCTION_FAILURE - a pinned digest matches but leg A diverges from the accepted reading (instrument defect: the accepted verdict does not reproduce) OR a hostile leg does not add its exact named gates (vacuous gate path) OR a hostile leg silently loses a previously failed gate
success_rule.exit_2: ENVIRONMENT - a pinned input is missing or its digest drifts; no leg is read
success_rule.no_weakening: the expected gate sets, the query keys, the transforms and the exit mapping are frozen here and may not be edited after commit; a changed accepted record is exit 2, never a silent re-pin

pre_observed_at_design.disclosure: the instrument designer, while building this hypothesis, executed both hostile transforms locally on the committed record through gates.evaluate and observed: leg B adds exactly {authority::baseline_lang_recall::corporate-criminal-liability::de, authority::baseline_recall::corporate-criminal-liability} and loses nothing; leg C adds exactly {duplicate::unique_ids::rent-default} and loses nothing. These exact expectations are frozen from that pre-observation (tier EXPLORATORY design probe, disclosed here); the claim-bearing run must reproduce them on a fresh execution with all pinned digests verified first.
pre_observed_at_design.not_pre_observed: leg A's reproduction on a fresh gates.evaluate call inside the claim-bearing run was not separately recorded; the accepted_reading counts come from the accepted record of record and must be re-derived, never copied.

claim_ceiling: verdict vocabulary is REPRODUCTION_MATCHES_AND_FALSIFICATION_PROVEN / FALSIFICATION_OR_REPRODUCTION_FAILURE / ENVIRONMENT. This instrument decides ONE thing: whether the frozen retrieval instrument reproduces the accepted run of record and can fail two deliberately regressed multilingual retrieval records. It does NOT re-run any live search, does NOT change the accepted record, does NOT re-score any label or geometry bar, does NOT claim the absolute retrieval bars are met (the accepted reading itself is overall_pass=false with 10 failed gates, preserved verbatim), does NOT unblock the human gate, and authorises no owner question.

reuse.multilingual_cells: the falsification targets are the FR/DE/IT authority-recall gates of the accepted frozen retrieval benchmark - the same cells the frontier OUTCOME_B negative leaves unrecovered
reuse.provenance_cells: the duplicate-injection leg targets the duplicate::unique_ids provenance gate
reuse.no_network: the whole run is offline over committed bytes; latency gates stay not_measurable and are never counted as passes
reuse.no_universal_174k: no universal-174k geometry benchmark is run
